trends.name: Strait of Hormuz Oil Shock
trends.summary: Iran formalizing control over Strait of Hormuz with 'secure passage' legislation while traffic stalls amid conflict. WTI crude surged above $100/barrel for first time since 2022, with Brent heading for record monthly gains. Saudi Arabia rerouting exports through Yanbu at near-operational limits, creating supply chain fragility.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Expectations Rise
trends.summary: BlackRock's Rick Rieder explicitly stated Fed should cut rates and will likely do so, contradicting recent inflation concerns. Powell reassured markets that inflation outlook is in check with no need to hike rates due to oil shocks, signaling pivot in Fed messaging.

trends.name: Middle East Geopolitical Escalation
trends.summary: NATO intercepted Iranian missiles over Turkey; Trump has signaled Iran war endgame 12 times in 5 weeks, now threatening destruction of Iranian infrastructure. Iran preparing to formally charge ships for passage, escalating control over critical waterway and increasing tail-risk scenarios for markets.

trends.name: Tech Stock Lagging Debate
trends.summary: Microsoft facing record stretch of underperformance igniting debate about Magnificent Seven concentration risk. Broader tech pullback signals rotation away from AI leaders; BofA identifies specific AI growth stocks as 'place to be,' indicating sector bifurcation.

trends.name: Risk-Off Market Sentiment
trends.summary: S&P 500 futures erased gains and turned red; energy/industrials/SMIDs sold off sharply. U.S. stocks faring worse than during past geopolitical shocks with significant downside room remaining. Treasury yields and dollar surging as investors flee risk assets.

trends.name: China Price Inflation & Trade Risk
trends.summary: Chinese suppliers warning of higher prices for Americans due to Strait of Hormuz closure and potential supply chain disruptions. Combined with geopolitical tensions, this signals stagflationary pressures and supply-side inflation risks for U.S. consumers.

trends.name: Semiconductor Earnings Weakness
trends.summary: Micron stock cratered 10% in post-earnings sell-off as competition catches up and margins compress. Signals broader chip sector headwinds despite AI boom narrative, raising questions about whether semiconductor super-cycle assumptions are overblown.

trends.name: Oil Shock Inflation Risk Assessment
trends.summary: 50%+ oil price surge over past month may be more than short-lived shock, potentially threatening recession outlook. Debate ongoing whether oil-driven inflation forces Fed to hold rates higher longer, creating macro policy crosscurrents.

trends.name: Bitcoin & Crypto Mainstream Adoption
trends.summary: Senator Lummis introducing bipartisan 'Mined in America Act' promoting BTC mining with capital gains tax relief. Square enabled automatic Bitcoin payments, causing merchant adoption to surge. 401(k) accounts moving closer to crypto integration, signaling institutional embrace.

trends.name: Earnings Season Mixed Signals
trends.summary: Palo Alto stock pops as CEO buys for first time in years, signaling confidence. Mixed earnings backdrop: NetApp shows rising billings despite low valuations; Corcept gains FDA approval with rating upgrade; Neumora faces setback. Selective opportunities amid broader volatility.

trends.name: Treasury Selling by Oil Producers
trends.summary: Middle East oil-producing countries actively selling U.S. Treasurys, reducing foreign demand for dollar-denominated assets. This capital flows shift reflects geopolitical tensions and could pressure Treasury yields and dollar strength longer-term.

trends.name: Airline & Shipping Cost Pressures
trends.summary: JetBlue raising checked bag fees as fuel costs soar; global shipping carriers facing Iran War impact on routes and costs. Inflation creeping into consumer-facing service sectors as energy prices force margin compression across transportation.
